name: equipment-ledger
description: Equipment ledger for a construction site store: issues, returns, reservations and an as-of reconstruction of the store at any instant.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @equipment-ledger/api" "npm run dev -w @equipment-ledger/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/api && npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run seed -w @equipment-ledger/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run typecheck -w @equipment-ledger/api && npm run typecheck -w @equipment-ledger/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run lint -w @equipment-ledger/api && npm run lint -w @equipment-ledger/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run test -w @equipment-ledger/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run test:unit -w @equipment-ledger/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run test:e2e -w @equipment-ledger/api
scripts.test:invariants: npm run build -w @equipment-ledger/shared && npm run test:invariants -w @equipment-ledger/api
